verdict.rationale: Dashboards and widgets are a fair question for a project-management product, but nothing in the evidence documents Asana's own dashboard or widget builder for reporting on project progress. What the pack does contain is adjacent only: an API tutorial for building your own status-update report app (a developer building block), MCP-driven report summaries via AI assistants (a different feature), and Fivetran exports to external BI tools (a user-side workaround). None of these counts as Asana delivering dashboards.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
